principle: Preserve the manufacturer's parameter name. Add universal, evidence-backed descriptions of the measured DSP dimensions it changes.

concepts.name: Transfer symmetry
concepts.definition: Whether positive and negative waveform excursions are processed equally.
concepts.engineeringEffect: Changes waveform symmetry and therefore the balance of even and odd harmonics.

concepts.name: Transfer shape
concepts.definition: The shape and progression of the processor's input-to-output mapping.
concepts.engineeringEffect: Changes how progressively peaks are bent, compressed, expanded or saturated.

concepts.name: Harmonic balance
concepts.definition: The distribution of energy across generated harmonic orders.
concepts.engineeringEffect: Changes which harmonic orders dominate and how the harmonic ladder develops.

concepts.name: Spectral tilt
concepts.definition: Broad weighting between low, middle and high frequencies.
concepts.engineeringEffect: Changes low-frequency lift, midrange emphasis, high-frequency roll-off or overall tonal slope.

concepts.name: Crest behaviour
concepts.definition: The relationship between average signal level and peak level.
concepts.engineeringEffect: Changes peak density or crest factor without necessarily changing average level by the same amount.

concepts.name: Residual fingerprint
concepts.definition: The signal added by the processor after the aligned dry component is removed.
concepts.engineeringEffect: Changes the level, spectrum, density or tonality of the processor's added fingerprint.

concepts.name: Timing response
concepts.definition: How energy arrives, overshoots, rings and settles in time.
concepts.engineeringEffect: Changes onset, ringing, impulse width, energy distribution or settling behaviour.

concepts.name: Phase response
concepts.definition: Frequency-dependent timing alignment through the processor.
concepts.engineeringEffect: Changes phase rotation or group delay across the spectrum.

concepts.name: Signal interaction
concepts.definition: How simultaneous tones create new sum, difference and higher-order products.
concepts.engineeringEffect: Changes intermodulation and how complex material becomes denser or remains separated.

concepts.name: Boundary behaviour
concepts.definition: Behaviour near DC, infrasonic, ultrasonic and level boundaries.
concepts.engineeringEffect: Changes stability, foldback, DC offset or other edge-of-range behaviour.
